title: Relational Reasoning, Memory, and Embedded Knowledge
description: Task-relative knowledge, exact recovery, future-preserving memory, checked append and recall, and enforced invariant-preserving transitions. Constructive Lean proofs accompany scoped finite-carrier RSI results and exact finite experiments. No universal intelligence ceiling is asserted. Includes source-checked persistent agent memory and captured live restart trials, retaining a failed arithmetic control.
notes: Manuscript and documentation: CC-BY-4.0. Python and Rust reference implementations and tests: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0. To verify the deposit locally, run 'python -m pip install ".[dev]"' followed by 'python -X utf8 -m pytest code/tests/test_rsi_impossible_lean_verification.py' and 'python -X utf8 verify_deposit.py --test --lean'.
